analysis: The trial succeeded with host validation macro HR@10 of 0.5188, improving over the supplied 0.505 baseline by 0.0138 (1.38 percentage points). Category HR@10 was 0.570 for Movies_and_TV, 0.550 for Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.360 for Electronics, and 0.595 for CDs_and_Vinyl. Electronics remains the weakest category. The result supports further investigation of the combined architecture and ranking loss, but does not establish which change caused the improvement. Allocated GPU time was 364.35 seconds; no test metrics were available.
code_summary: Trains one independent network per category: a two-block causal SASRec transformer with 96-dimensional embeddings, two attention heads, dropout 0.25, and a gated cumulative-history taste representation. Scores use normalized item and sequence embeddings, a learned scale, and jointly trained item biases. Training uses sampled-softmax cross-entropy with 192 shared uniform negatives, equal user weighting, AdamW, and gradient clipping. Validation selects one checkpoint per category with early stopping. The generated predictor routes datasets to their single trained checkpoint and uses the same scoring architecture; no ensembles or separately fitted scoring components are used.
